items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But Helen when you had all those rave reviews, John Wilson, well everybody because you had big rave reviews because of your appearance at The Cookery.

ctx.x: And then while I was there doing the New Year's Eve Party my father died. And so Barney said, you take care of everything and come on back.

But Helen when you had all those rave reviews, John Wilson, well everybody because you had big rave reviews because of your appearance at The Cookery. Must that have been for the New Year's Eve show? Maybe it was.
Well I did the New Year's Eve show, but then right after I started in the Cookery is when I started getting all these big raves.
